missions.title: Inside the Hekublade
missions.desc: Mikiko's heart has stopped. His soul lands somewhere quiet - and someone there is very annoyed about it.

lines.t: Hey! You're not supposed to be here! Master's going to be so upset!

lines.full: And FOUR of you?! {names}?! Master's going to explode!

lines.t: Your heart STOPPED, you idiot. Hold still. ...Fox Heal.
Ow... who ARE you?
Kaeru! You usually call me Heku. Master Kitsune put my soul in the blade - I'm its guardian.
And WHERE IS YOUR TAIL?! No wonder you're losing! Now get back in your body!
Kaeru! ...Uh.
You DUMMY! You're supposed to say Heku!
70%. Playtime is over, Xeno Warriors.
(That guy gives me the creeps.) TRUE EMPATHY!

steps.obj: Kaeru's True Empathy vs Ultima at 70%

escape_lines.t: Human speed modifications - gotta love them. Have a fun fight!
NOOOO! He took the blade! Mikiko, I TOLD you!

missions.title: Catch Kyle
missions.desc: Without Kaeru inside, the Hekublade is an empty shell - and Kyle has it. Follow her nose.

lines.t: I'll sniff him out. ...Why are you wasting Fox King mode on SMELLING?
I'm not half fox anymore, okay?!

choice.text: Have Mikiko fly ahead on the wind.

reply.t: Wind flight - Rhalix, your lessons better work!

lines.t: Master gave me the last of her fox power. That's why she has no tail anymore.
Fox kin can only give their blood twice. I wasn't the first one in this world.
...Who was?
She won't tell me. Now put me back, senpai. Go help Rhalix.

missions.title: Lunar
missions.desc: Rhalix's nights of meditating were trials: butterflies, ice, and the memories he lost. Under the moon, he's someone calmer.

lines.t: Meditating at night, I fell into a mental space. The first Skylander with the moon element was waiting.
Three trials. Butterflies - don't judge, it's a normal fear. Ice, underwater, with no way out but the light.
And the last: my lost memories. Even if they're gone, I'm still the one who did those things. I'm Rhalix Murasaki.

steps.obj: Lunar trial: stay calm in the dark

lines.t: Does that chip have a clock? 'Cause it's about time I kick your ass.
Rhalix blasts a hole in the roof. The moon pours in. Silver karma - and crescent moons in his eyes.
So. Ready for the real battle to start?
What the F—
Rhalix, is that you? Where's Max? He killed Royals.
You're not Kyle, are you?
Kyle's two floors down. Go have fun.
Max saved your life, Kyrie. Don't you owe him the same?

reply.t: ...Fine. But he's gonna kick your butt, Ultima. Later, Rhalix!
Four floors down, he said. Come on.

escape_lines.t: Moon Reflect! Right back at you.
Sky tech in my body - a sixth sense. There you are.
Cool new form, Rhalix! Let's see who lands more hits! FOX KING MODE!
